# Originality ledger

For each capability: what is kept from upstream and why, what changed in the method, which new example shows the change, what evidence says it is better, and what remains inherited. Upstream: [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d131814572224537fb516b8c5d33dd5fa67`. Every change is also visible as a diff from commit `6f0e6ae` (the unmodified import).

Reusing good upstream code is deliberate. Where a row says "paths only", SumitCraft's contribution to that skill is packaging, portability, a contract and a re-run, not a new method; it is not presented as original work.
